title: Conditional κ = .00389821053 (+0.00000333486361% over #8063; +0.00001359598380% over #8057): widen the signed Gaussian upper band
body:
## Verified result

**Conditional κ = 0.00389821053.** The exact gain over independently reproduced [#8063](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8063), at **0.00389821040**, is **0.00000000013**, or **(65/19491052)%**. The exact gain over the latest [external #8057 scientific claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier), at **0.00389821**, is **0.00000000053**, or **(53/3898210)%**. Both comparisons retain the same five signed all-size interfaces. The exact #8063 installed ceiling is below the new rate.

The literal Gaussian upper fence widens from **2⌊M/(2048·306)⌋** to **2⌊M/(1724·306)⌋**. At both real heights the new period is 1364, with slots (0,272,545) and first swap 1→272. This pays all finite charges at debit 64944/524288. The old divider cannot fund the new debit. Its original debit is a known-good control. The directed proof separately rejects H3=524394 at the new rate. The charged profile uses H3=524395, 514 entry conversion bits, first terminal header 2^1146346+2, recurring log₂ C≤318293671, and conservative fixed native setup ≤2^228.

## Reproduce

Use Git and CPython 3.12 from exact commit `e4fccb224ce5d9bc530a8027d4f617a6a37d4562`.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-weighted-upper-band
```

All seven local registered modes passed in 176.99 seconds, including both actual fences and heights, cutoff contacts, both signed native widths, full nested transfer and owner restoration, signed product −345550037539, and native setup. The detached replay authenticated 88 archived inputs and independently derived both paid signed budgets, the new and old factor controls, actual placement, and the insufficient ordinary height. Metadata, committed source and modes, onboarding (760 tests, 31 skips), and historical replay passed. K7 source and verifier hashes match the inherited receipt. All hosted checks passed on the exact head, including the actual seven-mode [scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45079873944/job/137386697152).
